csv_project_name: AE Services for Central Shipping and Receiving Relocation
csv_scope_of_work: The University of North Carolina at Pembroke is seeking letters of interest from qualified architectural and engineering firms to provide complete professional design and construction administration services for the relocation of the campus central shipping and receiving area. This project involves renovating/converting approximately 3300 sqft in the existing bookstore storage area into the campus central shipping and receiving area. This project involves demolition of walls, acoustical ceilings, some electrical circuits, repurposing of doors, relocating fire sprinkler piping, along with final floor, wall, and ceiling finishes.
